- Validate inputs as strings; if b is empty return True, if len(b) > len(a) return False.
- Generate the rotation superstring of b by concatenating b with itself (bb = b + b) and consider all rotations implicitly as substrings of bb of length len(b).
- Return True if any rotation of b appears in a: equivalently, check if there exists an index i in [0, len(b)-1] such that a contains bb[i:i+len(b)]; implement efficiently by iterating i and using substring in, early-return on match, otherwise return False.
